title: Personalised excellent tour

title: Walking tour - Gaudi and Modernist architecture
text: A really interesting and informative tour with a knowledgeable guide. Lili really personalised our tour and took us to places that we wouldn’t have found on our own as well as to some of the iconic buildings. Her knowledge and enthusiasm for Barcelona and Gaudi in particular was extensive.
